# Qdrant Memory MCP
**One Memory. Multiple Agents. No Lock-in.**

The Codex plugin candidate adds guided local
setup, read-only native-memory import and verified JSON

/Markdown handoff. It is
versioned independently and does not add a second Runtime. See the
executed

validation and limits. Exports remain
readable without this plugin or a subscription; native adopti

on is verified
separately from file creation.

Durable, portable, and permission-aware memory for AI agents — distributed as
an MCP adapter over th
e Qdrant Memory Runtime.
For shared production deployments, read the deployment security guide. Owner-only database write cre
dentials are required independently of MCP grants. Configure destination protection and shared docto
r before deployment. See the Owner support record for support limits.
## One Memory, Multiple Agents — opt-in shared owner
The distribution adds an opt-in single-owner service and stdio bridge. Install Runtime 0.6.0 to use
them. See shared integration guide. Private defaults are unchanged. Native Provider automatic shared
extraction is deferred.

## Install and initialize

For the shortest currently supported local setup, follow the
Ollama quickstart (中文).
It covers an ex

isting model, installing a missing model, a separate WorkBuddy
profile, connection settings and a fi

rst save/search check. No Qdrant server,
Docker, cloud account or embedding API key is needed for th

at local path.
Python/uv and one-time profile configuration are still required for this
direct route

. The managed WorkBuddy connector and DSH bundle prepare those
dependencies from Node.js instead.

Requires Python 3.11+ and either uv or a Python
virtual environment. You must configure storage and

an embedding service.
